items.title: 1. Streaming `read()` cannot be typed inline at a `match` scrutinee
2. Repeating type and initializer for multiple same-type accumulators
`runs()` in `stdlib/seq.cp` only accepts `List<T>`, not `Str`
items.general_fix: Make `runs()` generic over any sequence/slice (`Str`, `[D]T`, `List<T>`) and consider a zero-allocation `runs()` generator so $n = 2 \cdot 10^6$ strings don't pay for an intermediate `List<Char>`.

items.title:
Mixing `Int` expressions with `Mod

` requires explicit `M(...)` wrapping on every term
items.general_fix:
Allow `Mod

* Int`, `Int * Mod

`, and `Mod

+= Int` (reducing the `Int` mod `P` with Euclidean mod) when one side is already `Mod

`.

items.title: `Str` does not carry `s.len == n` from input, and `String` gives no suggestion for `Str`
items.general_fix: Suggest `Str` in the diagnostic for `String`, and support length-constrained string reads (or `Str` with `where s.len == n`) so `s[i]` is statically proven in-bounds.

items.title: `Action` and `Monoid` lower to `std::function` closures, causing 2.97x slowdown in `LazySegTree`
items.general_fix: Make `Monoid` and `Action` traits statically monomorphized in `SegTree<D, M, A>` (as in spec 27.2), so `op`/`apply`/`then` inline directly with zero `std::function` indirection; omit the `span` array

items.title: `?Node` is not niche-packed inside `LazySegTree`, nearly doubling runtime (232.6 ms -> 416.9 ms)
items.general_fix: Propagate niche values from `Int` (and domain/range) fields up to enclosing structs so `?Struct` uses an existing field's niche with zero size overhead, matching Rust's niche optimization and spec 11/

items.title: `LazySegTree<Bounds<Val>, ...>` fails to typecheck, forcing a separate `Cut = 0..=n` domain
items.general_fix: Make `D.Cut` / `Bounds<D>` a first-class `Index` domain accepted by generic containers (`SegTree`, `LazySegTree`, `Fenwick`) and cut-bounded ranges. Helps every problem indexing cuts alongside element

items.title: `swap(mut p[i], mut p[j])` is rejected even when `i != j`
items.general_fix: Provide `.swap(i, j)` on `[D]T` arrays (matching `List.swap`, O(1) even for non-copy elements and safe when `i == j`). Helps every permutation/array swap problem.

items.title: `Bitset<D>` lacks `.full`, direct `for v in bitset:` iteration, and `Bitset<D>.empty` symmetry with `Subset<D>`
items.general_fix: Unify `Bitset<D>` and `Subset<D>` surfaces (or merge into `Bits<D>` as in the 0.3 spec): provide `Bitset<D>.full` (filling words directly in O(K/64) without a temporary `[D]Bool`) and implement `Seq`

items.title: No `first` / `find` helper to pick the first element matching a predicate
items.general_fix: Add `.find(pred) -> ?T` (or `first(seq, pred) -> ?T`) on `Seq<T>` in `std.seq` (lazy, stopping at the first match). Helps every greedy/elimination loop that searches for an element satisfying a condit

items.title: `FlowGraph<V>` has no `.reset()` to reuse capacities across repeated max-flow runs (Gomory-Hu)
items.general_fix: Add `pub fn reset(mut self)` to `FlowGraph<V>` restoring `left[k] = cap0[k]` in O(E) without reallocation. Helps Gomory-Hu trees and binary-search-on-flow problems.

items.title: `all` / `any` do not accept a predicate without allocating a `List<Bool>`

items.title: Boundary-delimited `for j in hi.r..r.l:` yields `Rank.bounds` instead of `Rank`
items.general_fix: Make boundary-bounded ranges `b1..b2` / `b1..` / `..b2` consistently yield elements of `D` (positions between the two boundaries), matching the `V.bounds` design and `SegTree`/`LazySegTree` range sema

items.title: Initializing a `LazySegTree<D, Int>(AddMax, ...)` to a constant requires allocating a temporary array
items.general_fix: Add an optional `fill: ?T = none` parameter (or `.filled(act, val)`) to `LazySegTree` and `SegTree` constructors so constant-initialized trees skip the extra O(n) allocation. Helps every `AddMax`/`Add

items.title: Rollback `Dsu` cannot roll back companion per-component payloads, and marks are raw `Int`
items.general_fix: (1) Return a nominal `DsuMark` handle from `Dsu.mark()` instead of raw `Int`; (2) support a payload-carrying `Dsu<V, T>` (or composable rollback log) that snapshots and restores component payloads alo

items.title: Runtime-bounded integer fields in `read()` force either duplicating the max constant or losing arithmetic
items.general_fix: Allow runtime-bounded structural ranges (`0..=m`) in `read()` record/tuple field types (matching `read(0..=m)`), carrying the range fact `0 <= e.w <= m` into the prover so indexing `[0..=m]` is static

items.title: No reusable offline dynamic connectivity / D&C-on-time or dynamic tree in stdlib
items.general_fix: Add an offline D&C-on-time helper (segment tree of edge lifespans + rollback callback) to `local-lib` / stdlib, alongside `LinkCutTree` / `TopTree` for online dynamic tree problems.

`Map<List<Int>, Int>` / structural hashing for sequence/partition keys
items.general_fix: Derive lexicographic `Ord`/`Eq` (and `Hash`) for `List<T>` and tuples when `T` supports them, and provide `Set<T>.insert(x) -> Bool` returning whether `x` was newly inserted.

items.title: No stdlib `Comb<M>` (factorials, inverse factorials, binomial / multinomial)
items.general_fix: Include a lightweight `Comb<M>` (or `FactTable<M>`) in `stdlib/mod.cp` with `fact`, `inv_fact`, and `choose` (returning `0` out of range).

items.title: No built-in `Set<T>` with `insert -> Bool` for cycle/visited detection
items.general_fix: Provide `Set<T>` with `insert(x) -> Bool` in stdlib (alongside `Map<K, V>`).

items.title: Blocker: no accepted upstream C++ oracle

items.general_fix: Allow `?D` (optional of a finite domain `D`) as an array/grid index space (with `none` occupying the extra slot `D.len`), and define `min`/`max` or a `min_some` combinator on `?D`. Eliminates sentinel

items.title: Reverse suffix DP (`for i in (0..n).rev()`) splits `0..n` and `0..=n` index spaces
items.general_fix: Make `Boundary` / `Cut` positions of a domain work seamlessly with reverse iteration and `String`/`List` indexing so `tbl[i.before]` and `tbl[i.after]` are statically proven in-bounds.

items.general_fix:

` when the expected type is `Mod

` (in variable/array initializers, assignments, and `==`/`!=` comparisons).

items.title: Directional / skip-list DSU merges require manual pre-merge payload save

items.title: No dynamic tree (`LinkCutTree` / `TopTree`) in stdlib forces an extra log factor
items.general_fix: Add a generic `LinkCutTree` (and/or arena-backed `TopTree`) to stdlib/local-lib for dynamic trees and $O(\log n)$ amortized path-assign/color-run queries.

items.title: Blocker: no accepted upstream C++ oracle and no constructive checker in `gate.sh`
No custom checker hook in `gate.sh` for constructive / multi-answer problems
items.general_fix: Support an optional `proto/ports/ecnerwala/check/NAME.py` verifier in `gate.sh` (mirroring `cpl stress --checker`). Helps every constructive and approximate problem.

items.title: Symmetric 2D matrices require duplicating writes (`nonneg[i, j]` and `nonneg[j, i]`)
items.general_fix: Either a `SymmetricGrid<V, T>` / `AdjMatrix<V>` helper in stdlib, or a canonicalized unordered-pair key, so symmetric pair data is written once and safely queried in either order.

items.title: Counting predicates over a list (`deg`, `beaten_by`) requires 4-line manual loops
items.general_fix: Add `count(xs, pred)` (or `xs.count(pred)`) alongside `any`/`all` in the sequence utilities.

items.title: Blocker: no accepted upstream C++ oracle and no interactive gate support
Interactive I/O lacks a first-class flush/exit protocol and interactor harness
items.general_fix: Add an `ask(...)` helper (prints, flushes, reads response, exits cleanly on `-1`/EOF) and interactor support in `gate.sh` / `cpl stress` (`--interactor`). Helps every interactive problem.

items.title: Binary search over a predicate calling an interactive query needs slice concatenation (`pool[lo..=mid] + [u]`)
items.general_fix: Provide a `first_true(range, pred) -> ?Int` (or `bsearch` returning `?T`) and zero-copy slice concatenation / multi-arg `print` over slices without allocating intermediate lists.

items.general_fix: Add a parity/2-coloring DSU (or `Forest<V>` with `color(v)`) to stdlib/local-lib, composing naturally with `Dsu<V>`.
